props.tex: \begin{aligned}&\mathbf J_{\mathbf g}(\mathbf x)=\begin{pmatrix}2&1\\2&4\end{pmatrix},\qquad \mathbf h=\begin{pmatrix}0.1\\-0.1\end{pmatrix}\\\bigl(\mathbf J_{\mathbf g}(\mathbf x)\,\mathbf h\bigr)_i&=\sum_{j=1}^2\frac{\partial g_i}{\partial x_j}(\mathbf x)\,h_j\\\bigl(\mathbf J_{\mathbf g}(\mathbf x)\,\mathbf h\bigr)_1&=2\cdot0.1+1\cdot(-0.1)=0.2-0.1=0.1\\\bigl(\mathbf J_{\mathbf g}(\mathbf x)\,\mathbf h\bigr)_2&=2\cdot0.1+4\cdot(-0.1)=0.2-0.4=-0.2\end{aligned}
